description: Update project name, description, check thresholds, analyticsEnabled (cookieless edge traffic; off by default), shareGateEmails (optional OTP gate on platform hosts only; empty = public), siteMcp (off | read | forms visitor MCP on Pro/Scale), or owner-edit (data_edit_emails + data_edit_names, optional data_edit_path; Pro/Scale, off by default).

analytics_enabled.description: Enable cookieless edge analytics. Required true before get_project_analytics returns totals.

check_thresholds.description: Quality-check threshold overrides. Omit to leave unchanged.

data_edit_emails.description: Up to 5 owner emails for live /edit (OTP). Empty turns owner-edit off. Pro/Scale. Custom domains included. Requires data_edit_names.

data_edit_names.description: 1–5 collection names the owner may edit (e.g. menu, hours). Required when data_edit_emails is set.

data_edit_path.description: Single path segment for the editor (default edit → /edit). Letters, digits, hyphen.

description.description: New internal notes. Omit to leave unchanged.

name.description: New display name. Omit to leave unchanged.

project_id.description: Hosting project UUID from create_project or list_projects.

share_gate_emails.description: Up to 5 client emails. Non-empty turns on email OTP on *.novence.ai and /p/{suffix}/ only. Custom domains stay public. Empty array turns the gate off. Saving the list does not send mail.

site_mcp.description: Visitor Site MCP. off (default), read (list_pages + get_site_data), or forms (also list_forms + submit_form). Pro/Scale. Cannot enable while share_gate_emails is set. Control plane stays /mcp with nv_.

name: update_project_settings
title: Update project settings
